Most AI coding tools limit you to one chat and one task at a time. With the GitHub Copilot app, you can spin up multiple parallel sessions to handle distinct parts of your codebase simultaneously. Watch how one agent fixes a bug while others write tests and build new features without overwriting each other's work.

description:
Working with AI agents to write code can feel linear and isolated from the rest of your work. The GitHub Copilot app is built differently — it is the agent-native home for your work on GitHub, right on your desktop. In this beginner-friendly tour, see how to start a session, hand a real task to Copilot, watch it explore code, and run tests. 

Download the app today and learn how to navigate your new desktop workspace: https://github.com/features/ai/github-app?utm_source=youtube-copilot-app-ep1-description&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=copilot-app-for-beginners-series
